descriptions.zh-Hans: 在成都尝麻婆豆腐后写的菜单。菜名下面的小点，记着我等它稍凉一点的停顿。
descriptions.en: A card from trying mapo tofu in Chengdu. Pencil dots mark my pauses while the hot tofu cooled a little.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在成都尝过担担面后记下的菜单。背面留着我练菜名时添的一句“慢慢念”。
descriptions.en: My Chengdu dandan-noodle card, with “take your time” on the back from practicing the name.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在成都熊猫基地做的小索引，大熊猫和小熊猫各有一行，下面是我写的“今天慢慢看”。
descriptions.en: A little index from Chengdu’s panda base: separate lines for giant panda and red panda, followed by my own “take your time today.”

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我在成都记担担面菜名时写下的便条，读着读着，多出了一句自己的小提醒。
descriptions.en: A Chengdu note from practicing the name dandan noodles. A small reminder of my own slipped into the reading.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我在成都杜甫草堂写下“我在这里停了一会儿”。这是我的见闻，写在随身带的便纸上。
descriptions.en: “I stopped here for a while,” written on my own paper at Du Fu Thatched Cottage in Chengdu. A plain sentence from my visit.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在成都，一位旅人替我的两张菜单画了两个小方框，让我选先介绍哪一顿。
descriptions.en: In Chengdu, a traveler drew two boxes for my menu recital so I could choose which meal to introduce first.
